app.title: Świstak — invoices and local AI analysis
app.subtitle: Invoice archive • local Ollama
form.hint: Correct the extracted values using the original invoice. Review the summary before saving.
read.hint: Text extracted from PDF or OCR is input data only. After extraction, use the local model in the AI analysis tab.
read.placeholder: Extracted document text will appear here. Reading does not change the original PDF.
read.start: Select a PDF document to extract its text.
read.missing: No text detected. Check scan quality.
read.running: Reading PDF (text layer or local Tesseract)...
read.done: Done — {count} pages. {details}. Raw text only; not yet interpreted by LLM.
ai.hint: First use PDF text. The local LLM suggests values; Świstak checks their format, and you decide what to apply to the form. Nothing is saved automatically.
ai.model_tip: Name of a locally installed model (ollama list)
ai.start: Extract PDF text to start analysis with the local model.
ai.none: No current analysis. Extract the PDF and run Ollama.
ai.apply_tip: Applies format-validated suggestions to Edit data; does NOT save the invoice in SQLite
ai.next_step: After applying the suggestions, use Edit data and then Invoice. Nothing is saved automatically.
ai.working: Model {model} is analyzing the text locally. No data is being saved...
ai.done: Ollama ({model}) finished. {count}/{total} fields passed format/evidence checks — this does NOT confirm they match the bill. Verify against the PDF.
ai.failed: AI analysis failed; you can fill in the form manually.
ai.cancelled: Analysis cancelled — no changes to the form or database.
ai.cancelling: Cancelling: waiting for the current Ollama request to finish...
ai.confirm_body:
Apply {count} fields to Edit data?

Only format-validated fields with evidence or explicit manual confirmation are applied. Existing values may be overwritten. Verify against the original PDF before saving. This operation does NOT write to SQLite.
ai.saved_hint: AI suggestions moved to Edit data. Correct the values, open Invoice and explicitly save.
list.hint: Select an imported document to open or complete it.
doc.opened: Document opened. Choose full PDF or selected area extraction.
doc.selection_hint: Select an area of the PDF with the left mouse button.
doc.selection: Page {page} | relative area: left={left:.4f}, top={top:.4f}, right={right:.4f}, bottom={bottom:.4f} — use the PDF / scan text stage to extract the selected area.
msg.read_before_ai: Use the PDF text tab to extract the document first.
msg.model_required: Enter an Ollama model name, e.g. gemma3:4b.
msg.duplicate: This PDF is already archived — opened the existing document.
msg.saved: Invoice saved in the local SQLite database.
msg.read_status: Extraction finished; text was not saved to the database.
msg.read_cancelling: Cancelling after the current operation finishes...
msg.status: Imported original PDFs stay outside the Git repository
settings.title: Świstak settings
settings.help: Settings are stored separately from the bills database. Changing the model does not start an analysis.
about.title: About Świstak
about.body:
Świstak — a local bill manager

PDF · OCR · SQLite · Ollama

Publisher: Rafał Zacharski

Data remains on the user's computer. AI analysis requires a separately running local Ollama service.

Source code and license: github.com/DarkZachi83/Swistak
validation.account: Invalid account number (NRB/IBAN or checksum). Check against the original bill.
validation.period: Period start is later than period end
about.subtitle: Local bill manager • {version}
about.tagline: Was this bill extracted and completed correctly?
about.author: Rafał Zacharski with Atos
about.privacy: Your bills stay on your computer. AI analysis runs locally.
about.star_hint: ☆ Enjoying the app? Star it on GitHub to support further development.
workflow.title: WORKFLOW
invoice.title: Invoice — review
invoice.review: Verify edited values against the original PDF. The data will only be saved after clicking “Save invoice”.
invoice.no_document: Import a PDF or scan first.
invoice.saved: The invoice has been saved to the local database. You can reopen it in Documents.
ai.edit_hint: Double-click any value to correct the AI result. The program validates the data again. If OCR evidence is missing, select the row and manually confirm it against the original PDF.
ai.confirm_row_tip: Only after comparing with the original invoice. Date, amount and bank account format checks remain active.
ai.manual_confirm: Have you checked “{field}” directly against the original invoice? Invalid format still blocks transfer.
validation.manual: Manually confirmed against PDF — verify before saving
validation.value_mismatch: Value not supported by source evidence — check the PDF and confirm manually
patterns.title: Invoice templates
patterns.select: Select a template for this document:
patterns.load_error: Cannot load templates — analysis is available without a template
patterns.match_confirm: Świstak found a possible match “{name}” ({score}/100). Use its approved rules in local AI analysis? No old invoice values will be copied.
patterns.field_note_help: How should the agent recognize this field? Do not enter personal data, amounts, or bank account numbers:
patterns.select_field: Select a row in the AI results table first.
patterns.note_too_long: A hint must not exceed 450 characters.
patterns.no_field_note: No template hint for this field
patterns.notes_placeholder: For example: take the amount due from the summary, not line items. Do not include private data.
patterns.offer_new: The invoice was saved. Would you like Świstak to learn how to read this document type? Saving JSON requires separate approval.
patterns.offer_update: The invoice was saved. You can propose an update to its template. The previous revision will be retained.
patterns.read_first: Read PDF or scanned text first. No layout rules can be created without text.
patterns.dialog.help: Review and edit the JSON if necessary. Only rules, seller tax ID, and approved hints should be kept. Do not enter buyer details, amounts, or bank accounts. Nothing is saved until you click Approve and save.
patterns.form.intro: Edit rules using a form instead of raw JSON. Never include invoice amounts or bank account numbers. Saving requires separate approval.
patterns.form.name: Template name
patterns.form.rules_hint: Select the fields whose rules Gemma may use. Specify document labels, source and target formats, and optional hints. Do not put invoice values here.
patterns.form.preview_hint: Read-only view of the structure generated from the form. No manual JSON editing is required.
validation.billing_month: Billing period does not match the month on the PDF
validation.billing_derived: Billing period derived from the month on the PDF — please verify
patterns.manage_help: Select a saved template. Edit it with a form, deactivate it without deleting, or restore an earlier revision. None of these actions modifies saved invoices.
patterns.manage_status_confirm: Change “{name}” to status: {status}? A new revision will be created; saved documents and invoices remain unchanged.
patterns.manage_no_history: This template has no earlier revisions.
patterns.manage_restore_confirm: Restore “{name}” from revision {revision}? The current state will be preserved in history.
invoice.duplicate_confirm:
The invoice from “{supplier}” (number: {number}) is already in the database.
Saved document: {filename}

Overwrite the existing invoice?

This will replace its data and, if needed, link to the PDF document. Choose “No” to preserve the current entry.
invoice.overwrite_cancelled: Invoice was not overwritten. Existing data is unchanged.
invoices.hint: Saved invoices. Click a heading to sort; double-click a row to view or edit the linked document. All imported PDFs remain under Documents.
invoices.search: Search supplier, number, date, category or PDF filename…
qr.title: Read QR codes
qr.apply: Apply amount and account to form…
qr.running: Searching for QR codes in the document…
qr.found: QR codes found: {count}. Verify against the invoice.
qr.unknown: Unknown QR format — raw text (links are not opened):
qr.confirm:
Apply amount {amount} PLN and bank account {account} to the form?

Existing values in these two fields will be replaced. Verify against the invoice before saving. The program does NOT initiate a transfer.
qr.applied: QR data copied to the form; verify before saving.
ai.notes_scope: General notes and field comments are used when proposing a template after approving an invoice. The current analysis uses the selected approved template. Double-click the Comment column to add a field-specific hint.
models.search_hint: Show models available in local Ollama and models detected on disk, like AI Bóbr.
models.title: Local models — choose for Świstak
models.hint: Świstak analyzes invoices through local Ollama. Select a model on the Ollama tab. Models found on disk in other apps are informational only and must be imported into Ollama.
models.api_only: Only these models can be selected for invoice analysis. The list comes from the local /api/tags API.
models.disk_hint: A file on disk does not necessarily mean the model is registered with Ollama. Świstak does not load or copy these models. Import a file into Ollama separately.
models.no_ollama: No models available from local Ollama.
models.no_disk: No other models were found in the searched folders.
models.no_service: Cannot read the Ollama model list: {error}. Disk files can still be viewed, but start Ollama before analysis.
ai.progress.prepare: Agent is preparing local invoice analysis…
ai.progress.ollama: Ollama ({model}) is processing the invoice — waiting for response…
ai.progress.validate: Validating agent response: JSON, fields, and PDF evidence…
categories.title: Choose and organize categories
categories.hint: Check existing categories first. Select one rather than creating a duplicate. The number next to each name is the count of linked invoices.
categories.new_label: New category (only if none of the above fits):
categories.new_hint: A new category will appear separately in future expense statistics.
categories.similar: Warning! Similar categories already exist: {names}. Consider selecting an existing category.
categories.already: Category “{name}” already exists and is selected above. Use the selection button.
categories.similar_confirm:
New category “{name}” is similar to: {existing}.

Expense statistics will count them separately. Are you SURE you want a separate category?
categories.no_longer_available: This category is no longer available. Reopen the list.
categories.merge.title: Merge categories
categories.merge.hint: Select an incorrect category and the correct destination. Linked invoices will be moved to the destination and the incorrect category will be hidden. Amounts and original PDFs are not changed. Default categories cannot be retired.
categories.merge.preview: Number of linked invoices that will be reassigned: {count}.
categories.merge.select_both: Select two different categories to preview the merge.
categories.merge.confirm:
Move {count} linked invoices from “{source}” to “{target}”?

This changes category assignments in your database. “{source}” will be retired from active categories. Amounts, invoice numbers and PDF files are unchanged.

Back up important data before merging. Do you confirm?
categories.merge.pattern_error: Cannot safely inspect stored templates: {error}. Merge cancelled.
categories.merge.pattern_block:
Templates still reference the old category: {names}.

Update the category in those templates first, then retry the merge.
backup.title: Świstak backups
backup.busy: Wait until AI analysis or document reading finishes before creating or restoring a backup.
backup.private_warning:
The backup includes financial records, original PDF invoices, templates and local settings. The ZIP archive IS NOT ENCRYPTED.

Save it in a private, secure location outside the Świstak data folder.

Create backup now?
backup.restored:
Backup restored. A fresh Świstak window has opened.

Your previous data remains in:
{previous}

Do not delete it until you verify invoices, PDFs and templates.
clear.title: Clear the Świstak database
clear.warning:
WARNING! This command will erase ALL data!

Create a backup first.

All saved invoices, original PDFs, custom categories and AI templates will be removed. A new empty database with default categories will remain. Application settings will be preserved.

Świstak will first create a MANDATORY full ZIP backup. Continue?
clear.backup_title: Choose a location for the mandatory pre-wipe backup
clear.type_phrase:
Your backup was created and verified.

To permanently erase all Świstak data, type exactly:
{phrase}

Cancellation or any other text leaves your data untouched.
clear.last_confirm:
FINAL CONFIRMATION

Permanently remove all invoices, PDFs, templates and custom categories from Świstak's active data directory?

Verified ZIP backup:
{path}

Data can only be recovered from the backup. The default answer is NO.
clear.success:
The database has been cleared. Invoices, archived PDFs and templates are removed. Only default categories remain.

Your backup is still safely stored here:
{path}

This ZIP is not encrypted.

agent.model.local_only: Model unavailable or no records — local-only check
agent.model.model_ready: Local model completed its tool-based analysis
agent.model.model_error: Model analysis failed — reliable local totals shown
agent.state.model_error: Agent: LLM unavailable; local checks available
plan.title: Świstak — Bill Plan, History and monthly closure
plan.profiles.help: Profiles are expectations, not additional amounts due. Create a profile and choose a month to plan incoming bills.
plan.profile.name: Profile name:
plan.profile.hint: A profile does not create an invoice or payment. An expectation starts on the first day of the next month by default. Schedule changes create a new version.
plan.profile.confirm: Create profile “{name}”? No synthetic invoice will be generated.
plan.schedule.confirm: Save a new schedule version starting {cycle}? Previous versions remain in history.
plan.schedule.future_required: A new version must begin after the previous version start.
plan.duplicate: A profile with this name already exists. Review the list to avoid duplicates.
plan.col.name: Profile
plan.expected.title: Expected documents for selected month
plan.generate.confirm: Generate missing expectations for {cycle} from active schedules?
plan.exception.type: How should the document be classified?
plan.exception.confirm: Save the explanation for “{name}”? This creates no invoice or amount.
plan.exception.clear_confirm: Clear the previous explanation? The document will require review again.
plan.choose_exception: Select an expectation with an existing explanation.
plan.no_link_candidates: There are no eligible active invoices from the selected month.
plan.link.choose: Choose an invoice from the same month:
plan.link.confirm: Link the invoice to the expected document? This does not change the amount or payment.
plan.no_links: This expectation has no linked invoices.
plan.unlink.confirm: Remove the link? The invoice remains in the database.
plan.toggle.confirm: Change the status of profile “{name}”? Historical invoices and expectations remain intact.
history.summary: Invoices: {count} · Billed total: {billed} PLN · Paid for service month: {paid} PLN · Unpaid: {unpaid} PLN · Payments dated in this month: {paid_month} PLN · Withdrawn: {withdrawn}
history.audit.title: Change history for the month
history.mark_paid.confirm: Record payment dated {date}? It will be added to the audit history.
history.invalid_action: This action is unavailable for the selected invoice.
history.reason.confirm: You are confirming an operation with reason: {reason}. Proceed?
closing.explanation: Document completeness is a separate decision. A month remains financially unsettled until active invoices are paid. Uncertain expectations block closure.
closing.closed: CLOSED — all documents and no unpaid invoices
closing.documents_only: DOCUMENTS CONFIRMED — financial settlement remains open
closing.not_confirmed: NOT CONFIRMED — review invoices and expectations
closing.empty_check: I explicitly confirm no invoices were issued in this month.
closing.generated: Generated {count} expectations. Review and resolve them before confirming.
closing.too_early: Only a completed month can be confirmed.
closing.empty_required: Explicitly confirm there were no invoices.
closing.confirm.question: Have all documents for {cycle} been received or explicitly explained? Invoices: {count}; unpaid: {unpaid}. You will confirm COMPLETENESS, not payments.
settings.model_hint: Find locally: lists Ollama models and disk files. Invoice analysis only uses models available through Ollama. Select a custom folder in the search dialog; saving the settings remembers it for next time.
models.standard_locations: Scan standard locations (Ollama, LM Studio, Hugging Face, llama.cpp, GPT4All)
